description.value: Edo Japan at Totem Mall is a Canadian-founded Japanese-inspired fast food chain serving teppanyaki meals grilled fresh to order, hand-rolled sushi, ramen, and bubble tea. The Fort St. John location sits streetfront in Totem Mall off 96A Street, easily reached from the Alaska Highway. With over 200 locations nationwide, it offers dine-in seating, takeout, delivery, and catering.

Takeout and washrooms are confirmed by website ('Take-out' listed as a service) and OSM (takeaway=yes, toilets=yes) respectively. No mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content.
